footing_check: Clean. JV closed Apr 1, 2026 as expected (deleveraged: debt cut from ~$325M to ~$91M, ~$66M+ residual cash); no financing gap (the deal IS the financing), no guidance cut since T1.5. Q1 FY2026 lands Jun 9 (2 days out) = near-term catalyst, not a slip. Critically, the T1.5 card's "$45 tender + 33.5% pop already in the price" premise is WRONG: the $45 tender was a tiny partial buyback (2.22M sh, ~7.6% proration, WHP/insider-related); the broad equity reverted to ~$10.66 (Jun 5), cap ~$328M — so the "move already run" risk is NOT present, the pop faded. Footing clean -> spine.
theme: Monster-shape — apparel special-situation / brand-licensing JV catalyst (WHP Global JV); no Tier-0 HUNT-theme fit (flagged for Tier 0)
best_vehicle: LE itself (standalone special-situation; no benchmark cohort)
drop_reason: thin-setup-not-worth-a-slot — realistic ceiling ~2-3x SOTP re-rate (matches sell-side $32.50 "Strong Buy" PT ≈ 3x and forward P/E ~10x), below the great-trade 3-4x floor, unprotected, hinging on an unproven low-margin DTC turnaround + an undated/out-of-LE's-control WHP monetization swap; no ≥4x venture mechanism. Survives easily and the JV is genuine value-unlock (not financial engineering), but a defined-ceiling ~2-3x re-rate doesn't earn a scarce Tier-3 slot.

three_judgments.path: SOTP bull: LE's 50% JV stake ≈$300M (WHP paid $300M for the other half) ≈ the entire ~$328M cap -> operating biz 'nearly free.' Tested vs §7, the path ASSERTS not SHOWS: (1) the $50M/yr minimum royalty is paid BY LE's own operating sub INTO the JV — largely an intercompany transfer, LE gets 50% back; true incremental value = deleveraging interest (~$15-18M/yr) + LE's 50% of THIRD-PARTY/WHP-network licensing growth (licensing only ~6.4% of revenue). (2) Operating biz = 81% of revenue, flat-to-declining (FY25 rev -2%, GAAP NI $5.5M), now bearing a NEW ~$50M royalty that ~halves operating EBITDA on that line; Q4 +5% comp is a tentative low-margin apparel/uniform re-rate, not a venture mechanism. (3) Zero §7 discriminators: no backlog conversion, no on-date binary milestone, no firm fixed-price cash anchor, no margin/CF inflection; the WHP-monetization JV-stake-swap is real but UNDATED and outside LE's control (MOU-grade). Magnitude supports ~$20-32/sh = ~2-3x; a real ≥4x (~$43+/sh, ~$1.3B cap) needs a flat legacy retailer to compound like growth — heroic. Credible ≥4x NO; high-confidence protected 3-4x NO -> neither path.
three_judgments.asymmetry: bull ~2-3x (full SOTP re-rate + licensing scaling, undated) / base ~flat-to-+30% (deleveraged but a no-growth low-margin retailer trades ~8-11x earnings) / bear ~-30 to -40% (operating decline persists, royalty drag bites, stub de-rates). Rough U/D ~1.5-2x — adequate at best, not the dominant asymmetry that earns a scarce slot.
three_judgments.survival: Strong — no permanent-impairment risk. Post-deal debt ~$91M, ~$66M+ residual cash, ~$50M guaranteed royalty floor, profitable operating business. No going-concern, no dilution death-spiral, no debt wall. Not ruin (this prong clearly passes; it does not rescue the missing path).

strongest_bear: The deal is a de-risking LIQUIDITY event, not a value-creation engine: LE sold the only high-margin part of itself (licensing — ~6.4% of revenue but ~75% of profits) to WHP, kept a flat-to-declining low-margin DTC/uniform business now saddled with a $50M/yr royalty, and the "$300M JV stake" is half-funded by LE's own operating cash flow — so the apparent SOTP discount is largely illusory. The genuine upside (WHP-led international licensing) accrues 50% to WHP and is undated; the stub is a no-growth retailer worth ~8-11x earnings. The market re-rated it back to ~$10-12 (down from the pop) precisely because the incremental equity value is thin.
gate_lineage_line: T2 DROP (provisional type: none) · PATH: no qualifying path — SOTP ceiling ~2-3x (sell-side PT $32.50≈3x, fwd P/E ~10x), $50M min royalty is intercompany (LE's own sub pays in, gets 50% back), real incremental value = deleveraging + 50% of third-party licensing only ~6.4% of rev; zero §7 discriminators, WHP-monetization swap undated/out-of-control; not ≥4x, not high-confidence protected 3-4x. ASYMMETRY: bull ~2-3x / base flat-+30% / bear -30-40%, U/D ~1.5-2x marginal. SURVIVAL: strong — debt cut to ~$91M, ~$66M cash, $50M royalty floor, no ruin. STRONGEST BEAR: de-risking liquidity event not value creation — sold the high-margin licensing (~75% of profits) to WHP, kept a flat low-margin stub now bearing a $50M royalty; apparent SOTP discount illusory. DROP = merely-marginal (defined-ceiling re-rate doesn't earn a scarce slot), JV genuine value-unlock not financial engineering (T1.5 correct on that narrow point).
